原: What sort of bright ideas motivators make for effective willpower?
疑为: What sort of bright ideas, or motivators, make for effective willpower?
理由: bright ideas 与 motivators 直接相连不成句，前文说 bright idea 就是 motivator，应是同位关系漏了 or 或逗号；译作“什么样的好主意，也就是动力，才能造就有效的意志力呢？”。

原: And while expectant mothers have long been warned … from the Gulf of Mexico. Now there are three new species on the list …
疑为: And while expectant mothers have long been warned … from the Gulf of Mexico, now there are three new species on the list …
理由: while 从句被句号与主句切开（第 121、122 句）；按一句话分两半翻译。

疑为: I know you’re busy with work, …
理由: 句首漏了主语 I；译作“我知道你工作忙……”。

原: One 9-year-long study published in Psychosomatic Medicine. suggests not taking …
疑为: One 9-year-long study published in Psychosomatic Medicine suggests not taking …
理由: 主语和谓语被句号切成第 139、140 两句；按一句话分两半翻译。

原: you always have something to look forward to planning things and the anticipation that comes with it tends to make us happier
疑为: you always have something to look forward to. Planning things and the anticipation that comes with it tends to make us happier
理由: look forward to 后应断句，planning things and the anticipation 是后一句的主语；译文按两层意思用分号隔开。

原: … than at 10 a.m. While most experts agree driverless technology should help bring down accident numbers in the long term. Some have questioned whether it is safe.
疑为: … than at 10 a.m. While most experts agree driverless technology should help bring down accident numbers in the long term, some have questioned whether it is safe.
理由: 第 166 句把两句连在一起，而 while 从句又与第 167 句的主句被句号切开；按说话人的意思翻译（166 句后半与 167 句连成“虽然……但……”）。
